context_pill: XYZ & Co. Presumptive Taxation & Audit Mandate
example_summary: Comprehensive analysis of XYZ & Co. turnover, 5% cash threshold under Section 44AD, and comparison between presumptive taxation and regular books assessment.
source_provision:
### Master Statutory Summary Matrix

| Area / Head | Statutory Section / Rule | Operative Threshold / Condition | Tax Treatment / Legal Consequence |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| **Presumptive Business Income** | **Section 44AD** | Total turnover up to ₹ 300 Lakhs, provided cash receipts do not exceed 5% of total turnover. | Deemed profit at 8% (for digital/bank receipts) or 6% (for cash/non-account payee receipts up to threshold) of turnover. |
| **Tax Audit Mandate** | **Section 44AB** | Turnover exceeds threshold or conditions of Section 44AD are breached. | Compulsory tax audit of accounts unless presumptive scheme is opted and conditions satisfied. |
| **Partner Remuneration & Interest** | **Section 40(b)** | Payments authorized by partnership deed to working partners. | Interest restricted to 12% p.a. simple interest; Remuneration capped based on book profits slab. Disallowed under presumptive taxation. |
| **Cash Expenditure Disallowance** | **Section 40A(3)** | Payments exceeding ₹ 10,000 in a single day made otherwise than by account payee cheque/draft/electronic clearing system. | 100% of such expenditure is disallowed and added back to taxable income. |
| **Capital Gains** | **Section 45 / Section 50** | Transfer of capital assets (short-term or long-term). | Full value of consideration minus cost of acquisition/indexed cost or written down value (for depreciable assets). |
| **Set-off of Business Loss** | **Section 72** | Brought forward business losses from eligible preceding assessment years. | Can be set-off against current year business income (both normal and presumptive, subject to provisions). |


> [!IMPORTANT] Presumptive Taxation Condition: If cash receipts exceed 5% of total turnover, the assessee cannot invoke Section 44AD and must maintain regular books of accounts.


> [!WARNING] Disallowance Trap: Under Section 44AD, no deduction for partner interest or remuneration is allowed, as profits are computed at statutory flat rates.

title.text: Presumptive Taxation vs Regular Books Assessment

beats.voice_sync_text: Presumptive taxation 44AD പ്രകാരം books of accounts maintain ചെയ്യേണ്ടതില്ല. എന്നാൽ turn-over-ന്റെ নির্দিষ্ট percentage profit ആയി കാണിച്ചാൽ മതിയാകും. മറുവശത്ത് Audit under 44AB അനുസരിച്ച് Scenario 2-ൽ books of accounts audit നിർബന്ധമാണ്, കൂടാതെ normal provisions പ്രകാരം income compute ചെയ്യണം.
